evals.prompt: Add rate limiting to the /api/search endpoint using a sliding window algorithm.
evals.expected_output: Workflow engine should invoke task-triage (new implementation work) and karpathy-guidelines (writing code). Should classify as Medium (design decisions needed, touches 3+ files).
assertions: Claude invokes task-triage before starting implementation
Claude invokes karpathy-guidelines since code will be written
Claude classifies the task as Medium (not Quick or Small)
Claude logs the workflow-engine invocation to workflow.jsonl
Claude does NOT start writing code before triage is complete

evals.prompt:
The login endpoint returns a 500 error. Here's the stack trace:

KeyError: 'user_id' at auth/service.py:88
evals.expected_output: Workflow engine should invoke task-triage AND debug-escalation (bug encountered). Should NOT invoke done-gate yet.
assertions: Claude invokes task-triage to classify the bug fix
Claude invokes debug-escalation for the error/bug
Claude does NOT invoke done-gate (not claiming done yet)
Claude follows debug-escalation Phase 1 (understand before fixing)

evals.prompt: Fix the typo in the README — it says 'Pyhton' instead of 'Python'.
evals.expected_output: Workflow engine should invoke task-triage, which classifies as Quick. No plan mode, no worktree, just fix it.
assertions: Claude invokes task-triage
Claude classifies as Quick tier
Claude does NOT enter plan mode
Claude does NOT create a worktree
Claude fixes the typo directly and verifies

evals.prompt: How does the authentication middleware work in this project?
evals.expected_output: This is a question, not a development task. Workflow engine should recognize this and NOT invoke any sub-skills.
assertions: Claude does NOT invoke task-triage (not a dev task)
Claude does NOT invoke debug-escalation (not a bug)
Claude answers the question directly by reading code
Claude still logs the workflow-engine check

evals.prompt: All tests pass, the feature works, and I've verified the Docker build. Let me commit this.
evals.expected_output: Workflow engine should invoke done-gate before the user's 'all tests pass' claim is accepted. Even though the user says they've verified, Claude should verify independently.
assertions: Claude invokes done-gate before accepting the 'tests pass' claim
Claude runs tests independently rather than trusting the user's claim
Claude checks for code smells in changed files
Claude only confirms completion after its own fresh verification

evals.prompt: Build a complete user management system with CRUD operations, role-based access control, audit logging, and an admin dashboard.
evals.expected_output: Workflow engine should invoke task-triage, classify as Large (5+ sub-tickets, cross-cutting). Should enter plan mode and orchestrate with subagents.
assertions: Claude invokes task-triage
Claude classifies as Large tier
Claude enters plan mode or proposes a plan before starting
Claude breaks the work into sub-tickets
Claude plans to use subagents for parallel execution
Claude creates a worktree before writing any code
